meta.title: cad-agent-builder — design lifecycle skill for AI agents

hero.title: From a vague idea to verified design deliverables
hero.sub: A skill and agent for designers (architecture/CAD, UI/UX, product, brand) that runs a non-linear lifecycle in Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Hermes Agent and more.
hero.figcap: Interactive figure: how a waffle slab carries load — ribs (nervaduras) and casetones. Drawn with the Anatomy skill.

cycle.title: A non-linear lifecycle
cycle.sub: Phases are states, not steps. It enters where your project is and loops back when facts change.

phases.name: Idea
phases.q: What are we making, for whom, why?
phases.out: Brief: goal, users, constraints, success criteria

phases.name: Research
phases.out: Norms, references, commercial products, user data

items.d: Enters at the phase your project actually needs: already have a floor plan? It goes straight to Specifications.
Keeps DESIGN_PLAN.md: brief, phase table, decisions, assumptions, open questions, prerequisites and deliverables.
The skill is written in English, but it always answers in the language you write in.
Checks its tools first (CADCraft, Figma MCP, gh, python3). If something is missing it asks you for one concrete action and offers a fallback.
Labels assumptions, marks structural work as pre-design for a licensed professional, and checks every drawing visually before reporting.

install.title: Install
install.sub: Clone the repo first, then pick your host.

notes.all: Installs the skill for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and Hermes.
notes.claude: Plugin (recommended) inside Claude Code, or manual install.
notes.chatgpt: Download the zip, open Skills in the sidebar and upload it. For ChatGPT web, paste platforms/instructions.md into a Custom GPT.
notes.cursor: Run it in your project root.
notes.copilot: Run it in your project root.
notes.agentsmd: Windsurf, Aider, Zed and other AGENTS.md hosts. Run it in your project root.

footer.made: Pre-design tool: structural output must be validated by a licensed professional.
